intent: Enter the sunflower fields, discover a sheltered shortcut through the crops, and rejoin the valley above the farm.

sections.name: The familiar field path
sections.lesson: Low fences lead into the crop

signs.text:
The familiar field path
Low fences lead into the crop

Above the sunflowers
Use the raised crop walk

sections.name: The hidden crop route
sections.lesson: Look for gaps leading back beneath the leaves

signs.text:
The hidden crop route
Look for gaps leading back beneath the leaves

Over the farm fences
Climb past the seed stores

The shortcut rejoins the valley
Descend towards the familiar lane

secret_areas.name: The hidden potting room
secret_areas.hint: A gap beneath the ivy leads back into the hedge.
